Technical SEO.title: Google Explains 503s, Robots.txt Limits and Bracket URLs
Technical SEO.summary: Google advises sites to return 503 status codes during PHP patch downtime to signal temporary unavailability to crawlers. The update also covers robots.txt controls, bracket URL handling, and JPEG XL support in Google Images and Discover.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Overviews Nearly Double for Commercial Keywords
AI Search / GEO.summary: A study finds that Google AI Overviews have nearly doubled their presence for commercial keywords, signaling increased AI answer-surface competition for transactional and purchase-intent queries relevant to travel and enterprise verticals.

AI Search / GEO.title: AI Overviews Have Spread to Most Big-Brand Searches
AI Search / GEO.summary: AI Overviews are now appearing across the majority of big-brand search queries, indicating that large enterprise brands face growing displacement of traditional organic results by AI-generated answer surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: October 2026 Google Webmaster Report: Spam Update, Gemini 3.8, AI Contribution and Monopoly Rulings
AI Search / GEO.summary: The October 2026 Google Webmaster Report covers a spam update, the release of Gemini 3.8, AI contribution features, and ongoing monopoly rulings, offering a consolidated view of major Google developments relevant to enterprise SEO planning.

AI Search / GEO.title: What Actually Gets You Cited in AI Search (2026 Data)
AI Search / GEO.summary: A 2026 data study examines the ranking factors that determine which sources get cited by AI search engines, providing actionable intelligence for GEO strategy across enterprise content programs.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top Cited Domains Across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: This data study identifies the domains most frequently cited across major AI platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI, offering a benchmark for enterprise brands assessing their GEO visibility.

AI Search / GEO.title: Optimizing Visibility in Generative Engines: A Critical Survey of Generative Engine Optimization (2023-2026)
AI Search / GEO.summary: An academic survey covering three years of GEO research synthesizes findings on how content and technical signals influence visibility in generative search engines, providing a research-grounded foundation for enterprise GEO strategy.
